title: Backend.AI Deployment Config
description: Optional `deployment-config.yaml` placed in a model folder to pre-configure the image, resources and environment a deployment starts from. Every field is a default that deployment-time input (Add Revision form / API request) overrides. Any top-level key other than the ones listed here is read as a runtime-variant section (for example `vllm`), which overrides the root-level values for that variant only. The legacy `service-definition.toml` in the same folder carries the same shape.

image.description: Full path of the container image, read at the root level. Equivalent to `environment.image`.

architecture.description: CPU architecture of the image, read at the root level. Equivalent to `environment.architecture`.

Environment.description: Container image and architecture for the inference service.

image.description: Full path of the container image.

ResourceSlots.description: Compute resources allocated to each replica. Quote keys that contain a dot, such as "cuda.shares".

ResourceOpts.description: Additional resource options such as `shmem` (shared memory size).

Environ.description: Environment variables passed to the inference service container. Root and variant values are merged.

RuntimeVariantSection.description: Per-runtime-variant overrides (for example `vllm`, `sglang`, `tgi`). Only the fields listed in the section are overridden; everything else falls back to the root level.

image.description: Full path of the container image for this variant.

architecture.description: CPU architecture of the image for this variant.
